STATUS.NAME: Status
STATUS.DESCRIPTION: Status text, value, icon and color from up to 8 rules on the inputs I1..I8, shown in the visu (like the Loxone Status block)

INPUT.DESCRIPTION: Value for the rules and the placeholder <vN>

RULE.DESCRIPTION: Number of the rule that applies (0 = default)

DEFAULT_TEXT.NAME: Default text
DEFAULT_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Text when no rule applies. Placeholders: <v1>..<v8> value of the input, <v1.1> with 1 decimal

DEFAULT_VALUE.NAME: Default value
DEFAULT_VALUE.DESCRIPTION: Value (output Val) when no rule applies

DEFAULT_ICON.NAME: Default icon
DEFAULT_ICON.DESCRIPTION: Icon in the visu when no rule applies (Font Awesome name, e.g. circle-check)

DEFAULT_COLOR.NAME: Default color
DEFAULT_COLOR.DESCRIPTION: Color of text and icon in the visu when no rule applies

RULE_CONDITION.DESCRIPTION: E.g. I1 >= 20, I2 *= Alarm, I1 == <v2> or I1 > 20 && I2 == 1. Operators: == != > >= < <= *= (contains) !* (does not contain) : (starts with) !: (does not start with), join with && or ||. Text with spaces in quotes. The first true rule wins, empty = rule off

RULE_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Status text of the rule, placeholders <v1>..<v8> (<v1.1> with 1 decimal)

RULE_VALUE.DESCRIPTION: Status value of the rule (output Val)

RULE_ICON.DESCRIPTION: Icon in the visu (Font Awesome name, e.g. fire)

RULE_COLOR.DESCRIPTION: Color of text and icon in the visu

STATUS_MONITOR.NAME: Status monitor
STATUS_MONITOR.DESCRIPTION: Monitors any number of objects, counts them per state (up to 10) and shows the states, objects and an activity log in the visu (like the Loxone Status Monitor)

STATUS.DESCRIPTION: Objects to monitor (any number of links)

LAST_CHANGE.DESCRIPTION: Name and state of the object that changed last

REST.DESCRIPTION: Number of objects in no defined state

COUNT.DESCRIPTION: Number of objects in this state

LOG_ENTRIES.NAME: Activity log entries
LOG_ENTRIES.DESCRIPTION: Number of changes kept for the visu (0 = no log, max. 100); the log starts empty after a restart

REST_TEXT.NAME: Text for other values
REST_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: State text of objects whose value matches no state (output Csr)

REST_COLOR.NAME: Color for other values
REST_COLOR.DESCRIPTION: Color of the objects in no state in the visu

STATE_VALUE.DESCRIPTION: Value of the objects in this state: a number or text, a|b for several, empty = state not used. State 1 has the highest priority

STATE_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Text of the state in the visu and on Txlc

STATE_COLOR.DESCRIPTION: Color of the state in the visu

TRACKER.NAME: Tracker
TRACKER.DESCRIPTION: Event log: every value on I becomes an entry with time stamp, the last entries are shown in the visu (like the Loxone Tracker)

VALUE.DESCRIPTION: Value or text to log (any number of links)

TEMPLATE.NAME: Entry text
TEMPLATE.DESCRIPTION: Text of an entry: <v> value, <v.1> with 1 decimal, <n> name of the source

ON_TEXT.NAME: Text when on
ON_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Entry for the value on / true (empty = entry text)

OFF_TEXT.NAME: Text when off
OFF_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Entry for the value off / false (empty = entry text)

TEXT_GENERATOR.NAME: Text generator
TEXT_GENERATOR.DESCRIPTION: Generates up to five texts with the values of V1..V8 when Tr is switched on (like the Loxone Text Generator)

TRIGGER.DESCRIPTION: Rising edge generates the texts, falling edge clears them

DELAY.NAME: Trigger delay (ms)
DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Waits after the trigger so that all inputs are set

INTERVAL.NAME: Update interval (s)
INTERVAL.DESCRIPTION: Generates the texts again in this interval while Tr is on (0 = off)

TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Template of the output, placeholders: <v1>..<v8> value of the input, <v1.2> with 2 decimals (empty = output unused)

COMMAND_RECOGNITION.NAME: Command recognition
COMMAND_RECOGNITION.DESCRIPTION: Extracts a value from a text with a search pattern (like the Loxone Command Recognition)

PATTERN.NAME: Search pattern
PATTERN.DESCRIPTION: E.g. \iTemp: \i\v. Read: \v number, \h hex number, \1..\4 byte 1..4 of the value. Move: \. any character, \w word, \# number, \d digit, \a letter, \m letter or digit, \s12 skip 12 characters, \iText\i jump behind Text. Characters: \x09, \\ backslash, \t tab, \b space or tab, \r, \n; other characters must match

SIGNED.NAME: Signed values
SIGNED.DESCRIPTION: Bytes \1..\4 are read as a signed number

PULSE_BY.NAME: Pulse by text
PULSE_BY.DESCRIPTION: Pulse on P when the text on T contains one of up to four search patterns (like the Loxone block Pulse by)

PULSE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse when a pattern was found

DURATION.NAME: Pulse duration (s)
DURATION.DESCRIPTION: Length of the pulse on P; a new match restarts it

PATTERN.DESCRIPTION: Text the input has to contain; * = any characters, ? = one character, e.g. ???nder* matches grinder and thunderstorm (empty = unused)

IGNORE_CASE.NAME: Ignore case
IGNORE_CASE.DESCRIPTION: Upper and lower case do not matter
